brief:
Israel has allocated more than 52,400 dunams of Palestinian land for settler grazing purposes since the beginning of 2026, the Wall and Settlement Resistance Commission revealed, Shehab Wire reported. The land allocation represents a significant expansion of grazing areas available to Israeli settlers in the occupied territories.

The commission said the policy converts Palestinian agricultural land to support settlement expansion and settler economic activities in occupied areas.
